notes: Strip b: x 2320-3640 plus ~300 px overlap (2020-3940). Alms Place: printed 'PL.' between Foraker and Chapel and 'ALMS' south of Chapel (no suffix seen south); same alignment, recorded as Alms Place throughout; it drifts west from x~2635 at Foraker to ~2563 at McMillan. Lincoln Avenue jogs at Alms Place: west section y~3486 (printed 'AVE.', named LINCOLN further west), east section y~3343 (printed LINCOLN). Myrtle Avenue: west section y~4811 (MYRTLE), middle section y~4751 (printed AVE.) from Alms to Ashland south section, then a diagonal ESE to Ashland north section, then east at y~4845 (MYRTLE). Ashland Avenue: north section (Lincoln to Myrtle) slants from x~3557 to ~3471; south section (Myrtle to McMillan) at x~3245-3222. Preston Street jogs ~100 px west across Myrtle and its south section dead-ends at y~5202. Locust Street jogs at Ashland: west section y~6165-6175 (printed ST.), east section y~5990-6015 (printed LOCUST). The large tract between Gilbert, Victory Parkway and Foraker is the German Protestant Cemetery (no streets). The N-S avenue meeting Foraker at x~1985 and Lincoln at x~1950 lies outside this strip's overlap. Gilbert Avenue is printed 'AVE.' on this stretch (GILBERT printed to the SW).
